 'cos*x,v': lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*np.sqrt(v))+p[2]*np.cos(p[3]*t)*x+p[4]*v,
 'cos*v,x': lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*np.sqrt(v))+p[2]*np.cos(p[3]*t)*v+p[4]*x,
 'cos,x*v': lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*np.sqrt(v))+p[2]*np.cos(p[3]*t)+p[4]*x*v,
 'cos,x': lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*np.sqrt(v))+p[2]*np.cos(p[3]*t)+p[4]*x,
 'cos,v': lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*np.sqrt(v))+p[2]*np.cos(p[3]*t)+p[4]*v,
 'cos*Ev,x': lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*np.sqrt(v))+p[2]*np.cos(p[3]*t)*x+p[4]*t,
 'cos,t2': lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*np.sqrt(v))+p[2]*np.cos(p[3]*t)+p[4]*t**2,
 'exp t,v': lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*np.sqrt(v))+p[2]*np.exp(-p[3]*t)+p[4]*v,
 'cos*v,t2': lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*np.sqrt(v))+p[2]*np.cos(p[3]*t)*v+p[4]*t**2,

}
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
out=[]

    bestr=None
    for trial in range(60):
        p0=rng.uniform(-2,2,5); p0[1]=abs(p0[1])+0.1; p0[3]=abs(p0[3])*1.5
